name: io.github.ljcl/intervals-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for intervals.icu run data and analysis

environmentVariables.name: PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public HTTPS URL used for the Strava OAuth callback

environmentVariables.name: STRAVA_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional initial access token from setup-auth

environmentVariables.name: STRAVA_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional initial refresh token from setup-auth

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret gating /mcp and the OAuth web routes (recommended when internet-facing)

environmentVariables.name: ROUTE_EXPORT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directory for exported route files
